_doc: Upstreams we take code from (D33). pin says how to find the version we use. policy: watch for upstreams we forked (read their changes, take what helps, no obligation to stay cherry-pickable, D38), cherry-pick for code we changed, bump for code we use as is. tools/upstream_report.py reads this. OpenVT is not tracked: the app is a fork of it, not a downstream (user 2026-10-31).

upstreams.name: ayagami-gd
upstreams.note: Forked as Katashiro (D37, D38), no engine patch. Read new commits for ideas and fixes. Check every commit's source: nothing written from the Cubism SDK or Framework (D26).

upstreams.name: libfunnel
upstreams.note: PipeWire video out (D34). Maintained best-effort by its author, who asks to fork for new features: our copy is a fork, we fix what we need.

upstreams.name: ayagami

godot.note: Official builds (D38: Katashiro needs no engine patch). Take patch releases after the update gate; a new minor gets its own test round. The blend mode PR is watched: when merged, Katashiro can use exact blend modes.
